purpose: Identical pinned positive/negative subjects for the matching-logic slice comparison (wiki/drafts/matching_logic.md). Each negative declares its positive twin in its header comment; the pairs exercise the same proposition surface so any checker comparison runs the same subject on both routes.
surface: bare-file compile via `omega --check <dir>/main.omg` — positive must exit 0; negative must exit nonzero and emit the recorded expected diagnostic fragment (same contract as the fail corpus's expected.txt).
